text: Current photonic matrix processors can update their weights as fast as they perform a matrix-vector product, which makes them ideal engines for on-chip training.
explanation: False: weight update is the unsolved bottleneck. Thermo-optic tuning takes microseconds to 100 microseconds and PCM writes take microseconds to milliseconds with limited endurance, far slower than the ~10-100 ps optical transit. Thus these are inference accelerators with quasi-static weights, and training remains electronic.
